meta.title: Hypixel SkyBlock Farming Master Knowledge Base
meta.status: canonical research entry point; newer verified live behavior overrides this file
rules: Never use Alpha/coming-soon values in live calculations.
Never invent unknown formulas or drop chances.
Reverify any value older than the newest relevant Farming patch.
Rank marginal value from the player's current state, not raw stats alone.

farming_fortune.marginal_value: base_crop_drops / 100 per valid crop break per +1 point

crop_fortune.rule: +1 Crop Fortune is equivalent to +1 Farming Fortune only for normal drops of its matching crop; value is 0 for other crops

overbloom.rule: Since 2026-05-14 listed non-guaranteed Pest drops scale with Overbloom instead of Farming Fortune

pest_overbloom.rule: Do not apply to non-Pest rare-crop rolls

magic_find.scope: only loot tables that explicitly use Magic Find
magic_find.rule: Never add Magic Find to Overbloom

bonus_pest_chance.rule: Do not treat as Pest loot quality or Farming Fortune

farming_wisdom.use_when: player is below a required/desired Farming skill level

greenhouse_yield.rule: Separate effect layer; do not convert to Farming Fortune without context simulation

value_conversion.reason: Their value depends on crop throughput, Pest/RNG roll rate, eligible drop pools and prices
value_conversion.coin_per_hour_per_1_crop_ff: same as +1 FF only for matching crop; otherwise 0

upgrade_evaluation.rule: Keep coin and time axes separate unless user explicitly supplies a coin value for their time

armor.endgame_speed_rule: After Sundial unlock, prefer full current Farming boots rather than Rancher's Boots for Garden endgame unless a specific exception is verified

reforge_branches.thorny: Farming Fortune + Overbloom; gains extra Overbloom from worn Armor Thorns tiers

tools.modern_rule: Farming Tools level with Tool XP and can gain Fortune/rarity/Gemstone progression

pets.rule: No single universal pet progression; evaluate per context
notable: Orchid Mantis for Tool XP/Speed interactions

cross_stat_dependencies: Accessory Power/Tunings -> Strength -> Mooshroom Cow -> Farming Fortune
Rarity/Recombobulator -> stronger rarity-scaled reforge -> Farming/Overbloom/BPC delta
Armor Thorns tiers -> Thorny Equipment -> additional Overbloom
Unique Visitors -> Mosquito -> Sugar Cane Fortune
Crop Milestone -> Dedication -> matching Crop Fortune
Sundial -> crop-specific Speed cap -> full Farming boots remain usable
Speed -> real blocks/sec and therefore output/hour
Temporary whitelisted FF buff -> Hypercharge -> amplified buff; never multiply total FF

pufferfish_hat_celebration.rule: Evaluate as a complete helmet replacement; never treat the +2.0 contribution from all five tiers as the marginal gain.

permanent_and_account_progress.status: reverify against current 0.27 data before optimizer auto-applies

permanent_and_account_progress.value: historically up to +60 FF at visitor progression

permanent_and_account_progress.status: verify exact current item text before auto-apply

cultivating.time_factor: remaining crop breaks / crop breaks per hour

crop_fever.role: temporary proc; FF + rare-drop behavior; model uptime/rolls rather than permanent FF

pesterminator.status: resolve current 2026 full level table before exact ranking

green_thumb.role: Equipment Fortune scaling with unique Visitors

thorns.indirect: Each Thorny equipment piece grants +0.1 Overbloom per worn armor Thorns tier

reforges.mutual_exclusion_rule: Only one compatible reforge per item; always compare the lost alternative effect

hypercharge.role: amplifies only whitelisted temporary FF sources

chips.time_factor_rule: remaining Sowdust / measured Sowdust per hour plus duplicate-chip rarity requirements

god_potion.rule: evaluate contained effects separately; never assign a fake single FF value

pesthunter_philip.current_0_27: +5 FF per Pest, cap 200 = +1000 FF max

dark_cacao_truffle.status: 0.27 Cocoa-specific behavior requires exact live recheck before global use

pests.critical_rule: Do not use Farming Fortune to scale 2026 non-guaranteed Pest loot unless a specific mechanic explicitly says so
pests.artifact_toggle_rule: Pesthunter Artifact can make more BPC undesirable in some contexts; model enabled/disabled state

feast.overbloom_rule: +1 OB = +1% relative eligible Rare Crop probability
feast.freshly_baked_rule: during Feast double only the accessory's own Overbloom, not total account Overbloom
feast.grand_feast: Finnegan extension with Kernels/Grand Bakery progression
feast.jerry_rule: Grand Feast no longer copied by Jerry Perkpocalypse after 2026-06-19

greenhouse.unlock: Garden 7 + Carpenter progression; Beth progression for mutation analysis
greenhouse.rule: Optimize output per real maintenance interval; more visible Growth Speed is not automatically better if water/decay becomes limiting
greenhouse.unknown: exact current order of operations for base yield, Evergreen, Fortune, Greenhouse Yield must be tested/verified rather than guessed

visitors.rule: A first-time unique Visitor may have positive long-term value despite poor immediate coin EV

composter.profit_formula: expected Compost/hour * net Compost value - Organic Matter cost/hour - Fuel cost/hour
composter.opportunity_cost: self-farmed crops are not economically free

contest.rule: historical crop-score cutoffs are patch/Finnegan/meta dependent; do not hardcode old values as current

meta_strategy.normal_crop: Maximize successful breaks/sec plus effective FF and matching Crop Fortune; use Sundial + full modern Farming boots in endgame
meta_strategy.pest_spawn: Prioritize BPC/cooldown using Mantid/Squeaky/Vermin and appropriate pet/loadout
meta_strategy.pest_loot: Prioritize Overbloom/Pest Overbloom; Thorny + Thorns can matter. The Thorns V celebration Pufferfish Hat is a niche swap candidate only after subtracting the replaced helmet's full stats and set effects.
meta_strategy.feast: Optimize Overbloom, Rare Crops, Seasoning/Kernels and event progression
meta_strategy.tool_leveling: Treat Tool XP/Cultivating as time investments
meta_strategy.chip_leveling: Treat Sowdust and duplicate Chips as time/resource investments

dynamic_inputs_required.rule: Do not hardcode market prices in long-lived research data

source_policy.important: Every concrete mechanic used by production calculations should gain a source and lastVerified date in the normalized research/data layer

pest_loadout_progression.core_rule: Keep Farming, Pest Spawning and Pest Killing as three logical phases even when phases reuse the same physical gear.

farming.armor: 3/4 Mossy + 1/4 Mantid Helianthus or current progression equivalent

spawning.timing: swap only shortly before effective Pest cooldown expiry

killing.pet_role: Pest-killing pet such as Hedgehog; Poignant Clover when appropriate

endgame_two_armor_baseline.full_minmax_pet_copy_rule: A second Rose Dragon with Poignant Lucky Clover can be dedicated to Killing while the Green Bandana Rose Dragon remains dedicated to Farming.

ultra_minmax_optional_third_set.farming: full Mossy Helianthus + Rooted Farming equipment + Green Bandana Rose Dragon
ultra_minmax_optional_third_set.spawning: full Mantid Helianthus + Squeaky Pesthunter/Pest Vest + Brown Bandana Mosquito
ultra_minmax_optional_third_set.killing: 3/4 Mossy + 1/4 Mantid Helianthus + Thorny equipment + Poignant Lucky Clover Rose Dragon

pest_loadout_progression.data_model_rule: Phase loadouts may reference the same physical armor/equipment object; do not infer duplicates from phase separation.
